test_title: PYST 74: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

LM_O_NPMRO_KU_TI
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: LM_O_NPMRO_KU_TI

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) RPMO → LM__R__O / __P__NPM / RO__M__K / U__O__TI

Option 2) PNOR → LM__P__O / __N__NPM / RO__O__K / U__R__TI

**Option 3) NORP**** **→ LM__**N**__O / __**O**__NPM / RO__**R**__K / U__**P**__TI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14b8eb6cca4575a0b4ddd48c977198d9282ac3c3c3a5d7af9ac69ee4739d4928.png] 

Option 4) NOPR → LM__N__O / __O__NPM / RO__P__K / U__R__TI

Hence, the correct answer is **"NORP".**
